name: Asuka
source:
A young girl and member of a kendo dojo club.

In Viper-V10 ("Northern Lights" story), Asuka appears at the protagonist's training hall to challenge him.

In Viper-CTR ~Asuka~, she becomes his girlfriend after the events of the previous story.
